direction: Approved H3 number illustration and R4 broad royal figures with flowing edges. Values and small suit indices are rendered independently by the game.
sourceFormat: Versioned high-quality JPEG. Local original generator PNGs are retained but ignored by Git. Optimized runtime sizes are generated by Bun.Image.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the old ENGRAVED CLUB J/Q/K sheet and defines visual style and identities: fine vintage etched/crosshatched lines, detailed natural faces, red/black/gold period clothes, muted olive scrolls, cream grain, mirrored double-headed royals and central club motifs. Image2 is approved R4 ONLY as layout/EDGE reference. Produce an art-only ENGRAVED CLUB three-card sheet, exactly three equal aligned columns Jack, Queen, King, 1536x1024. Transfer R4's continuous thin rounded OUTER perimeter and softly flowing INNER contour around naturally quiet upper-left and lower-right paper corners. Preserve broad and substantial original royal figures, full faces/crowns/hands and sword or staff. Do not squeeze people into narrow diagonal ribbons and do not flatten the engraving style into the bold folk woodcut reference. Keep the original intricate engraving quality and club decorative motifs in clothes/jewelry. Remove ALL J/Q/K letters, numbers and small standalone corner suit indices; no text at all. Retain large decorative club motifs in the illustration. No header strip, inset miniature card or pasted patches. Complete equal-cell sheet with all edges visible.
